description: Universal Event Tracking requests to the Microsoft Advertising collection endpoint.

params.name: ti
params.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID. Microsoft documents how to create and install the tag but not the request format, so this rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Copy the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising into the tag snippet.

params.name: Ver
params.description: It is the UET tag version the snippet reports.

params.name: evt
params.description: It names the event, such as a page load or a custom event.
